title: Even Droids Celebrate
description: EVEN DROIDS CELEBRATE birthdays (front) in this whimsical art by Bunny Carter for Drawing Board Greeting Cards. "Hope your birthday is out of this world!" the card exclaims. Ms. Carter also pictures Artoo and Threepio taking a joyride in Luke's landspeeder (back) near Uncle Owen's moisture farm on Tatooine. "Blast off for the happiest birthday you've ever had," the droids say in this line of cards that came out in 1984.
